info.title: vid2context HTTP API
info.description: Turn any video into context for AI agents: transcripts, metadata, chapters, sections, outlines, context packs and bundles. Errors share one body: { error: { code, message, hint? }, attempts }.

get.summary: The transcript rendered by a formatter.
get.description: skip= removes SponsorBlock segments (sponsor, selfpromo, ...; 1 for the defaults) from a copy of the transcript; the raw transcript stays stored. translate=1 (with lang) returns the transcript in lang: the platform's own track or translation first, then LLM translation that keeps every timestamp. X-Translated-Via says which (source, platform or llm).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Any input a source understands: a video URL, a YouTube id, upload:<sha256>, or a local path (Node, not in public mode). URL-encode it.

parameters.name: timestamps
parameters.description: 1, true or yes to prefix lines with timestamps where the format allows.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Preferred transcript language, BCP-47 (en, de, pt-BR).

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Comma-separated SponsorBlock categories to remove, or 1 for the defaults.

parameters.name: translate
parameters.description: 1 to translate into lang when the platform has no track in it. Needs lang.

200.description: The rendered output. Content-Type is the chosen formatter's MIME type.

X-Translated-Via.description: With translate=1: source, platform or llm.

post.summary: Upload an audio or video file; returns an input (upload:<sha256>) for the other routes.
post.description: Size cap VID2CONTEXT_MAX_UPLOAD_MB (default 100). Kept for VID2CONTEXT_UPLOAD_TTL_MIN minutes (default 60), in R2 when the storage backend has a bucket bound, else in memory, and never saved to the library. Reduce large videos to audio before uploading.
